chunks: He said, 'Yes, and indeed you will be among the honored (al-Muqarrabun).'

key_terms.المُقَرَّبِينَ: The honored ones; those brought near to God, a high rank in Paradise.

ai.seo_question: Who are the Muqarrabun in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Prophet Muhammad and his Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate 'Muqarrabun' (those brought near), highlighting their unique spiritual station. It underscores the concept of divine proximity not merely as a reward, but as a result of steadfast faith and adherence to the divine path, a theme central to Shia understanding of the Imams' role as intermediaries of closeness to God.
